subject: Request: 24-hour pilot access maintenance while security review completes

To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Cc: security.ops@emberhealth.com
Date: Sat, 11 Sep 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot pause — security review holding off access

Hi Tessa,

Quick update from our side — our InfoSec team just paused the sandbox environment while they run an additional data handling check. Procurement is still in-flight but they said they can’t clear tokens until the security team signs off.

We’re mid-run of a 5-day integration test and I’m worried the evaluation signals will be lost if we don’t keep the sandbox alive. Is there any way Redwood can keep the account accessible for another 24 hours while the security folks finish the review? We don’t want to lose the demo momentum.

I can provide the security reviewer’s contact if that helps.

Thanks,
Claire
Product Operations | Ember Health

Hi Claire —

Thanks for the heads-up and for looping in security. I’m sorry you hit this during the integration window. We can provision an emergency 24-hour access bridge while your InfoSec completes the review, provided we capture a couple of quick confirmations (I’ve listed below). Ben and Marcus are on copy to expedite approvals on our end.

What we need from you to proceed immediately:
- Confirm the reviewer contact (name + email) so we can coordinate an evidence share.
- A short confirmation that no PHI will be persisted in the sandbox logs beyond the session (one sentence is fine).

If you can reply to this thread with those two items, I’ll push a provisional extension and send a short access-stub and usage-logging that your team can review. We’ll also attach scoped evidence docs for your InfoSec.

I’ll flag this as time-sensitive; we’ll hold for your confirmation and then extend access within 30 minutes.

—Tessa
